ask: Is it fine to fix the test and leave the app as it is?
problem: A nightly test said the Language sheet should have 16 rows but found 17.
found: The app is right. Tagalog was added as a new app language recently. The test was never told, so it still counted the old list.
changed: The test now expects 17 rows and lists Tagalog last. The app is unchanged.
why: This is a test left behind by the Tagalog work, not a product fault, so no quarantine tag is needed. I could not run the browser test here; the nightly run will show it. The tutorial video narration still says fifteen languages; I left it alone.
touches: Nothing else. Only one test file changed.
